speaker: john_harrison
text: You have been at three stalls already, and you have bought nothing. I saw you from the board. A page here, a gathering there. That is a man stretching his legs, not a man in want of a book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the first free morning I have had in six weeks. I came to read standing. I did not come to carry a parcel home.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Your Venus moves, Master Shakespeare. The Lucrece is… respected. I say it as I would say it of another man's book, because that is how they leave the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Respected is a quiet word. Moves is not. I hear which of them you trust.

speaker: john_harrison
text: They ask for the poem. That is the better sort of asking. Young gentlemen buy Venus to tuck in a doublet and Lucrece to leave open on the parlour table. Bring me a third poem and name your earnest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have been busy with a comedy. That is the earnest I have. I have not a third poem in my head, and I will not promise you one to make the board look fuller.

speaker: john_harrison
text: A comedy. You say it the way a man says he has been ill and is now well enough to stand. I will not ask the name of it. Names do not sell a poem, and a poem is what I know how to keep on a board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not ask the name. It is not licensed. It is with the book-keeper, and it is not a poem, and it will not lie on your board.

speaker: john_harrison
text: I have scarce a dozen Lucrece left. Tomorrow the term brings the lawyers in, and lawyers buy what they can leave open where a client may see it. A dozen will not last them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then you will be quit of the dozen, and I will still not have a third poem. I am glad they move. I am not glad enough to stand here and invent a title for you.

speaker: john_harrison
text: The Walk is all of a wedding at Greenwich on Sunday. Every stall has it, and none of them has it from a person who was invited. I tell you so you do not hear it first as a secret.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have heard it as news. I am leaving it where the Walk has it. I did not come to carry it home.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Good. Feasts buy poems when they are over, if they buy anything. Today they only talk. Will you take a copy of your own Lucrece, since I am about to be short of them?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. I have read it. Three stalls were enough standing, and a fourth book in my hand would only be a reason to stay out.

speaker: john_harrison
text: A dozen is a dozen. I am not rounding it to please a poet. When the lawyers have had their look, I may have three, and three is a board with a hole in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then sell the dozen. I cannot write you a thirteenth before tomorrow, and I would not if I could. The comedy is enough work for a man who has just got his mornings back.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Six weeks without a free morning is a long time to leave two poems to sell themselves. They have managed it. Venus more than the other. I give you that without a compliment, because a compliment does not reorder a stall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will take the report and not the compliment. Respected is what you said. I am not going to argue a poem into a better humour than its buyers have.

speaker: john_harrison
text: The buyers of Lucrece leave it open on a parlour table and think themselves serious. The buyers of Venus tuck it away and read it. I know which sale I trust. I am still asking you for a third, and you are still not naming an earnest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The earnest is the comedy, and it is not for this board. Titus is at two, and I am in it. That is the afternoon. The Siege of London is the Rose. I am not going across the river to see how another house spends a Wednesday.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Then go and play, if that is your afternoon. The lawyers come tomorrow. I will still be here, with fewer Lucrece than I should like, and with Venus moving off the board whether you stand over it or not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fewer than a dozen, by the time I am next free. I have heard you. I am not promising to be free.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Free is not my affair. The board is. Good morning, Master Shakespeare. Try not to read the whole churchyard a second time on an empty purse. You have already spent the morning correctly, which is to say you spent nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing bought, and nothing promised. If the lawyers ask you for the poem, tell them it moves, or that it is respected. You know which word is which. I am going.

speaker: john_harrison
text: I knew which word was which before you came in. Go and be in your Titus. The board will not wait on a comedy.
